1.e4 d5 2.f3 g6 3.d4 dxe4 4.c3.strategy: Declines to recapture: after Black takes on f3 and White retakes with the knight, White is a pawn down with only quick development and a solid pawn pair on c3 and d4 as compensation. Black can simply keep the pawn and develop, so this is a risk, not a plan.
1.e4 d5 2.f3 g6 3.d4 dxe4 4.c3.name: Barnes Opening: Gedult Gambit
